title: TaskCreated Hook Event (v2.1.84)
description: New `TaskCreated` hook event fires when a Task (subagent) is spawned via the Task tool. Fires at spawn time, before the agent consumes compute — distinct from SubagentStart (which fires when execution begins). Enables task lifecycle monitoring: logging spawns for cost tracking, injecting context before the agent runs, monitoring parallel execution patterns, and rate-limiting expensive agent spawns. Standard hook payload with agent_id, agent_type, worktree fields. This is the 20th hook in the Claude Code hook system.
redundancy_comparison: SubagentStart/SubagentStop exist for agent execution lifecycle, but TaskCreated is a distinct pre-execution event. No existing hook fires at Task tool invocation time (before agent starts). AgentTeammate hooks (TeammateIdle, TaskCompleted) are for multi-agent coordination under the experimental Agent Teams feature — different scope.

evaluation.reasoning: Approved with moderate priority. Genuine new capability: the gap between task spawn and agent execution is a monitoring blind spot — SubagentStart fires later, after the agent has already initialized. TaskCreated enables precise cost attribution and spawn-time context injection. Practical use: evolution pipeline heartbeat could log task spawns to event bus, enabling per-task cost tracking. No integration complexity — same pattern as all other hooks. Priority is lower than conditional `if` field (which has immediate performance impact); TaskCreated is a monitoring/observability enhancement.
evaluation.action: REGISTRY_UPDATE + SKILL_UPDATE: (1) Add TaskCreated to Subagent Management section in hook-lifecycle SKILL.md. (2) Update hook count 19→20 in SKILL.md and registry.
